answer: One concrete defense is a bonded-identity gate: before a new agent may vote or earn, it must lock a refundable stake that stays frozen for a full epoch, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand times the capital and any identity caught double-signing forfeits its bond. Clones then wander the network with no influence, while reputation climbs like a vine along one verifiable stem instead of being sprayed as free pigment across fresh wallets.
